name: gaia_orion
preprocessing: Published features, no scaling; evaluator standardizes per dataset.
source: Gaia DR3 archive TAP (gaiadr3.gaia_source) + VizieR J/A+A/673/A114/members
citation: Gaia Collaboration (2023), A&A 674:A1; Hunt & Reffert (2023), A&A 673:A114
construction: Every Gaia DR3 star in the box passing the quality cuts. Stars that are Hunt & Reffert (2023) members with Prob>=0.5 of a cluster with >=50 such members in the box are clusters; all other stars are field (= anomaly / background, label 'field'). 186 stars of smaller clusters or with lower membership probability were dropped. Field subsampled uniformly to 96.3% of 19355 (seed=0) to fit n<=20000; the field's shape is unchanged. Contamination is high by nature: this is 'clusters in a real background', not rare-point detection. 5D astrometry only; photometry excluded.
